candidates.statement: Payment service returns 503 on POST /v1/authorizations, causing order to fail and gateway checkout to return 502. Traces show payment 503 propagating to order 502 and checkout 502 across multiple correlation IDs.
candidates.uncertainty: Payment metrics show zero request counts in the 60s window despite trace 503s; payment-side logs were excluded, so the internal payment failure mode is unconfirmed.

report.explanation: Traces consistently show payment returning 503 on /v1/authorizations, which propagates to order 502 and gateway checkout 502. Inventory reservations succeed (200). The bounded candidate is a payment-origin HTTP 5xx fault; payment logs were excluded, so the specific internal cause remains unconfirmed.
missing_evidence: Payment service logs (ev-e6d655b275753975-r1-payment_logs) to identify why /v1/authorizations returns 503
Payment dependency/readiness metrics showing non-zero traffic to confirm the 503 source
Order service logs to confirm payment 503 is the propagated failure rather than an order-internal fault
